reasoning: Under the required precedence, the verdict is FAIL_HIDDEN_CASE_DEPENDENCY because A2 requires knowing that Renee performed the dismissive handoff, and that fact appears only in the sibling case. The same gap is an unsupported standalone token premise and leaves the demanded second action underdetermined, so both lower-precedence failures are recorded. C1's sibling details are corroborative rather than necessary: the standalone causal link between a dismissive, incomplete handoff and missed monitoring is sufficient to rank the communication-breakdown option above routine friction and an isolated knowledge deficit. A1, P2, and P3 are independently supported by the standalone stem.
